pairs: Factum est autem in die qua complevit Moyses tabernaculum,
Now it happened in the day when Moses completed the tabernacle,
unxitque et sanctificavit cum omnibus vasis suis,
and he anointed and sanctified it with all of its vessels,
altare similiter et omnia vasa ejus:
and similarly the altar and all of its vessels,
obtulerunt principes Israël et capita familiarum, qui erant per singulas tribus, præfectique eorum, qui numerati fuerant,
that the leaders of Israel and the heads of the families, who were in each tribe and who were in charge of those who had been numbered, offered
munera coram Domino sex plaustra tecta cum duodecim bobus.
their gifts in the sight of the Lord: six covered wagons with twelve oxen.
and they offered these in the sight of the tabernacle.
Then the Lord said to Moses:
Suscipe ab eis ut serviant in ministerio tabernaculi,
“Receive these things from them, in order to serve in the ministry of the tabernacle,
et trades ea Levitis juxta ordinem ministerii sui.
and you shall deliver them to the Levites, according to the order of their ministry.”
having received the wagons and the oxen,
Duo plaustra et quatuor boves dedit filiis Gerson,
Two wagons and four oxen he gave to the sons of Gershon,
The other four wagons and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari,
et octo boves dedit filiis Merari secundum officia
according to their offices and service,
sub manu Ithamar filii Aaron sacerdotis.
the son of Aaron the priest.
Filiis autem Caath non dedit plaustra et boves:
But to the sons of Kohath he gave no wagons or oxen,
quia in sanctuario serviunt, et onera propriis portant humeris.
because they serve in the Sanctuary and they carry their burdens on their shoulders.
Igitur obtulerunt duces in dedicationem altaris, die qua unctum est, oblationem suam ante altare.
Therefore, the leaders offered, at the dedication of the altar on the day when it was anointed, their oblation before the altar.
And the Lord said to Moses:
Singuli duces per singulos dies offerant munera in dedicationem altaris.
“Let each of the leaders, on each of the days, offer their gifts for the dedication of the altar.”
Primo die obtulit oblationem suam Nahasson filius Aminadab de tribu Juda:
On the first day, Nahshon, the son of Amminadab of the tribe of Judah, offered his oblation.
fueruntque in ea acetabulum argenteum pondo centum triginta siclorum,
And in it were these: a silver dish weighing one hundred thirty shekels,
phiala argentea habens septuaginta siclos, juxta pondus sanctuarii,
a silver bowl having seventy shekels, according to the weight of the Sanctuary,
utrumque plenum simila conspersa oleo in sacrificium:
and both were filled with fine wheat flour sprinkled with oil as a sacrifice,
mortariolum ex decem siclis aureis plenum incenso:
a little mortar made from ten shekels of gold, filled with incense,
and a one-year-old lamb as a holocaust,
et in sacrificio pacificorum boves duos,
and for the sacrifice of peace offerings:
Hæc est oblatio Nahasson filii Aminadab.
This was the oblation of Nahshon, the son of Amminadab.
Secundo die obtulit Nathanaël filius Suar, dux de tribu Issachar,
On the second day, Nathanael, the son of Zuar, the leader of the tribe of Issachar, offered:
acetabulum argenteum appendens centum triginta siclos,
a silver dish weighing one hundred thirty shekels,
a silver bowl having seventy shekels,
according to the weight of the Sanctuary,
utrumque plenum simila conspersa oleo in sacrificium:
and both were filled with fine wheat flour sprinkled with oil as a sacrifice,
mortariolum aureum habens decem siclos plenum incenso:
a little mortar of gold having ten shekels, filled with incense,
and one-year-old lamb as a holocaust,
et in sacrificio pacificorum boves duos,
and for the sacrifice of peace offerings:
Hæc fuit oblatio Nathanaël filii Suar.
This was the oblation of Nathanael, the son of Zuar.
On the third day, the leader of the sons of Zebulon,
obtulit acetabulum argenteum appendens centum triginta siclos,
offered a silver dish weighing one hundred thirty shekels,
a silver bowl having seventy shekels,
by the weight of the Sanctuary,
utrumque plenum simila conspersa oleo in sacrificium:
and both were filled with fine wheat flour sprinkled with oil as a sacrifice,
a little mortar of gold weighing ten shekels,
and one-year-old lamb as a holocaust,
et in sacrificio pacificorum boves duos,
and for the sacrifice of peace offerings:
Hæc est oblatio Eliab filii Helon.
This is the oblation of Eliab the son of Helon.

obtulit acetabulum argenteum appendens centum triginta siclos,

by the weight of the Sanctuary,
utrumque plenum simila conspersa oleo in sacrificum:
and both were filled with fine wheat flour sprinkled with oil as a sacrifice,
a little mortar of gold weighing ten shekels,
and a one-year-old lamb as a holocaust,
et in hostias pacificorum boves duos,
and for victims of peace offerings:
Hæc fuit oblatio Elisur filii Sedeur.
This was the oblation of Elizur, the son of Shedeur.

et in hostias pacificorum boves duos,
and for victims of peace offerings:
Hæc fuit oblatio Salamiel filii Surisaddai.
This was the oblation of Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai.

obtulit acetabulum argenteum appendens centum triginta siclos,

by the weight of the Sanctuary,
utrumque plenum simila conspersa oleo in sacrificum:
and both were filled with fine wheat flour sprinkled with oil as a sacrifice,
a little mortar of gold weighing ten shekels,
and one-year-old lamb as a holocaust,
et in hostias pacificorum boves duos,
and for victims of peace offerings:
Hæc fuit oblatio Eliasaph filii Duel.
This was the oblation of Eliasaph, the son of Reuel.

by the weight of the Sanctuary,

and one-year-old lamb as a holocaust,
et in hostias pacificorum boves duos,
and for victims of peace offerings:
Hæc fuit oblatio Elisama filii Ammiud.
This was the oblation of Elishama, the son of Ammihud.
the leader of the sons of Manasseh,
obtulit acetabulum argenteum appendens centum triginta siclos,
offered a silver dish weighing one hundred thirty shekels,
a silver bowl having seventy shekels,
by the weight of the Sanctuary,
utrumque plenum simila conspersa oleo in sacrificum:

and a one-year-old lamb as a holocaust,

and for victims of peace offerings:

This was the oblation of Abidan, the son of Gideoni.

by the weight of the Sanctuary,

On the eleventh day, the leader of the sons of Asher,
obtulit acetabulum argenteum appendens centum triginta siclos,

On the twelfth day, the leader of the sons of Naphtali,
obtulit acetabulum argenteum appendens centum triginta siclos,

a silver bowl having seventy shekels,
by the weight of the Sanctuary,

This was the oblation of Ahira, the son of Enan.
Hæc in dedicatione altaris oblata sunt a principibus Israël, in die qua consecratum est:
These were the oblations from the leaders of Israel for the dedication of the altar on the day when it was consecrated:
ita ut centum triginta siclos argenti haberet unum acetabulum,
such that each dish had one hundred thirty shekels of silver,
et septuaginta siclos haberet una phiala:
and each bowl had seventy shekels,
in commune vasorum omnium ex argento sicli duo millia quadringenti,
putting all of the vessels from silver together, two thousand four hundred shekels,
by the weight of the Sanctuary,
and twelve little mortars of gold, filled with incense,
weighing ten shekels by the weight of the Sanctuary,
all together one hundred twenty shekels of gold,
boves de armento in holocaustum duodecim,
and twelve oxen from the herd as a holocaust,
and for victims of peace offerings:
Hæc oblata sunt in dedicatione altaris,
These were the oblations for the dedication of the altar,
And when Moses entered into the tabernacle of the covenant,
audiebat vocem loquentis ad se de propitiatorio quod erat super arcam testimonii inter duos cherubim,
he heard the voice of One speaking to him from the propitiatory,
which is over the ark of the testimony between the two cherubim,
and there he also spoke to him.
